name: browser_visual_probe
description: Capture bounded browser screenshots for local, file, localhost, or external product surfaces using a fresh browser profile. It can also start a dev server, wait for the target URL, capture screenshots/DOM, flag primary-surface geometry risks for board/grid/game UIs, and stop its owned server process. Use this directly for your own claimed visual/UX evidence lane when a runnable surface exists; status=warn means screenshots were captured but semantic visual review/repair is required. Arguments arrive as JSON on stdin; artifacts are written under RHIZOME_TOOL_ARTIFACT_DIR.

artifact_contracts.name: screenshots
artifact_contracts.description: Viewport screenshots captured during the probe.

artifact_contracts.name: probe_report
artifact_contracts.description: Structured probe result and visual risk summary.

url.description: Preferred target. Any http(s) or file URL to inspect, such as http://127.0.0.1:5173 or https://example.com.

html_path.description: Optional fallback path to an existing HTML file. Relative paths resolve under RHIZOME_TOOL_WORKDIR; absolute local paths are allowed.

start_command.description: Optional dev-server command to start before probing. Use a string for shell execution, or an argv array. The tool waits for url/port, captures evidence, then stops the owned process tree unless keep_server is true.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for start_command. Relative paths resolve under RHIZOME_TOOL_WORKDIR; absolute host paths are allowed.

port.description: Optional dev-server port. Used to derive http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ when url is omitted and exposed as PORT/RHIZOME_SMOKE_PORT_HINT to start_command.

path.description: Optional path to append when deriving a URL from port. Defaults to /.

wait_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a started dev server to respond. Defaults to 30 seconds, capped at 90 seconds.

keep_server.description: Leave the owned dev server running after capture. Defaults to false.

require_clean_git.description: Require the target cwd git checkout to be clean before and after capture. This is enabled automatically for read-only validation checkouts under project-checkouts/review-* and foreign agent project checkouts.

expected_head_sha.description: Optional exact candidate HEAD guard. When present, the tool requires the cwd git HEAD to match and the checkout to stay clean before/after capture.

markers.description: Optional text markers to search for in dumped DOM.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-browser-process timeout, capped by the bundle.

allow_external.description: Deprecated. External targets are allowed in this trusted local runtime.
